messages.subject: Error reading annotation file
parts:
Hi,
I've worked through the methylKit tutorial (http://methylkit.googlecode.com/git/inst/doc/methylKit.pdf) up to section 3 successfully. But in section 4, when I tried to load the bed file for A. thaliana I get the following error.

> gene.obj=read.transcript.features("TAIR9_mRNA.bed.gz")
Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges") : 
  solving row 3: negative widths are not allowed

The bed file was downloaded from http://www.igbquickload.org/quickload/A_thaliana_Jun_2009/TAIR9_mRNA.bed.gz.

I do understand that the error is triggered from IRANGES package. But still, do you have any suggestion for fixing this issue? Thanks.

Indika

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Error reading annotation file
parts:
I think the problem is in the file structure. Usually, Column 11 and 12 of the bed file contains the blockSizes and blockStarts which denote the start and length of each exon. What is out of ordinary about that file is that for "-" strand blockStarts do not start with 0 and the order of the start positions in the blockStarts column is reversed. Below is  an example. Where column 11 and column 12 is reversed for "-" strand.


> ref[ref$V4=="AT5G08160.1",]
    V1      V2      V3          V4 V5 V6      V7      V8 V9 V10
2 chr5 2625558 2628110 AT5G08160.1  0  - 2625902 2627942  0   6
                       V11                       V12
2 385,143,144,186,125,573, 2167,1523,1269,928,659,0,


column 11 should be:
573,125,186,144,143,385,

column 12 should be:
0,659,928,1269,1523,2167

You can pre-process (perl, awk, etc. ) the BED entries on "-" strand and reverse the order of values in column 11 and 12, and then it should work. The function which extracts the intron coordinates from the BED file, assumes such an order and that's why it throws an error where a GRanges object with negative width can not be created.

Best,
Altuna
